description: Go source file implementing Linux-specific file descriptor operations such as open, stat, access, readlink, and retrieving mount IDs, with wrappers around unix system calls.

methods.name: prepareAt
methods.description: Prepares file descriptor and path for at-based system calls, returning a directory file descriptor and an informational path string.

methods.name: Openat
methods.description: Wrapper around unix.Openat to open files with specific flags and mode, ensuring O_CLOEXEC is set.

methods.name: Fstatat
methods.description: Wrapper around unix.Fstatat to retrieve file status information.

methods.name: Faccessat
methods.description: Wrapper around unix.Faccessat to check file accessibility.

methods.name: Readlinkat
methods.description: Wrapper around unix.Readlinkat to read symbolic links.

methods.name: GetMountID
methods.description: Retrieves the mount ID associated with a given directory and path, using unix.Statx with fallback handling.
